goals: Verify the system's ability to handle a sudden flash crowd traffic spike, triggering appropriate scaling mechanisms (e.g., RF + Waterfall cascade).
Verify the system's ability to handle a sudden drop in traffic, demonstrating effective anti-flapping and smart scale-in behavior.
activities: Configure the test to target the specified frontend host.
Set user wait times between 1 and 2 seconds for subsequent tasks.
Define the primary user action as sending a GET request to the root path ('/') of the frontend.
For the first 2 minutes, initiate a stable load phase with 50 concurrent users, spawning at 5 users per second, each repeatedly sending GET requests to the frontend.
From 2 to 5 minutes, simulate a flash crowd spike by increasing the load to 500 concurrent users, spawning at 100 users per second, each repeatedly sending GET requests to the frontend.
From 5 to 7 minutes, simulate a sudden load drop by reducing the load to 10 concurrent users, spawning at 5 users per second, each repeatedly sending GET requests to the frontend.
After 7 minutes, terminate all user activity and end the test.
